summary: Ochre Hill fire tower in Terra Nova National Park. Parks Canada's road leads to it, and a 2023 blog describes climbing to a platform. No build date found.

access.note: Parks Canada's road leads up to the tower; a 2023 blog describes climbing to a viewing platform; an OpenStreetMap editor reports public access.

visit.trail_note: The trail is about two thirds of the way up Ochre Hill Road, which runs from Route 1 up to the tower.

notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing or fire history found. A Parks Canada Facebook post, seen only in a search snippet (the page would not open), says the first Terra Nova fire tower was built on Ochre Hill in 1959. Not cited because it could not be opened; follow up with that post or a Parks Canada history page. The CBC piece on dark-sky status timed out and is not cited. Current status and access are well covered by Parks Canada; the blog and OpenStreetMap are informal sources.
